02/19.01.2023

The applicant who is in custody since 18.07.2022 has approa Court for grant of regular bail in connection with S.T. No.151 of 2022 arising out of Jaldega (Orga O.P.) P.S. Case No.23 of 2022, corresponding to G.R. Case No.286 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 376/ 493/313 of IPC.

entities.text: Jaldega (Orga O.P.) P.S. Case No.23 of 2022
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It appears that the applicant and the victim both are aged about 30 years.
Physical relationship has been established on the false pretext of marriage.
They were in relationship for last four years.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.

Considering the above facts, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/-
(Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Simdega in connection with S.T. No.151 of 2022 arising out of Jaldega (Orga O.P.)
P.S. Case No.23 of 2022, corresponding to G.R. Case No.286 of 2022, subject to the conditions that the applicant will submit self attested copy of his Aadhaar Card and also give his mobile number before the learned court below which he will not change during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Shahid/
